body:
**💀 SIAM UNSTABLE SMP 💀**  
*Unstable Experience — Pure Chaos Survival*

**🔥 About the Server**  
Siam Unstable SMP is a __fan-made replica of the Unstable SMP series__.  
This is a true chaos survival server where almost anything is allowed and every decision matters.

Death has consequences. Trust is fragile. Chaos is constant.


**⚠️ Core Gameplay Rules**
• 💀 Death = **12 HOURS BAN** (high-stakes survival)  
• 🔥 Griefing, stealing, raiding — __ALLOWED__  
• ⚔️ Combat logging = auto-kill + 12 hours ban  
• ✗ No hacking or cheating  
• ✗ No lag exploits or game-breaking bugs  
• ✓ Everything else goes  


**🎮 Server Features**
• 🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat (Simple Voice Chat plugin)  
• 🎮 Full Crossplay — Java + Bedrock  
• 🕒 Always Online, high uptime & performance  
• ⚔️ Hardcore-style punishment system  


**🔊 Voice Chat**
Proximity voice chat with ~60 block range.  
If players are nearby, they can hear you — adds realism and chaos.


**🌍 How to Join**

**Java Edition**  
IP: __play.siam-unstable.space__  


**Bedrock Edition**  
IP: __play.siam-unstable.space__  
Port: __19132__  


**❓ FAQ**

**• Is this official Unstable SMP?**  
No. This is a fan-made replica, not affiliated with the original series.

**• Is the server free to play?**  
Yes! Completely free. Donations are optional.

**• Is Bedrock mobile supported?**  
Yes. Mobile, console, and PC Bedrock players can join.


**🧠 Final Note**
This server is __NOT for everyone__.  
If you like safety, claims, and protection — this isn’t it.  
If you like chaos, tension, and real consequences — welcome home 😈

**Join Discord for updates & announcements!**
